text:
You need someone who can help build Manychat bots for your agency clients on a regular basis, with a focus on lead generation and smooth chatbot flows.

I’m Noor Halden, and I bring 6 years of experience in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. While my background is broader than Manychat alone, I’m comfortable working in automation-heavy, chat-driven systems and can support the kind of ongoing bot builds you’re looking for.

On a recent project for Tidewater Outfitters, I built product recommendation carousels trained on 1.2M interactions using Python, PyTorch, implicit, Redis, and AWS SageMaker. That work improved click-through rate by 14% in a 4-week A/B test.

I’d be glad to help you with repeatable Manychat builds for local business clients and keep the process efficient as your workload grows.
